text:
mira: quick heads up — EU canary p95 jumped to ~2.1s right after the release. Deploy bot didn't auto-revert. Thinking we should consider an operator override. :eyes:

deploybot: notice: canary-latency-eu spike detected at 6188801100. auto-revert not triggered: policy=conservative, require sustained 5m over threshold.

oliver: thanks. metrics show spike started ~6188801085, flattened at 2.1s. not sure if noise or steady. can we give it 10m?

jay: +1 to short wait but we need a clear threshold for manual. my call: do manual rollback if p95 >1.6s for 10 consecutive minutes AND error rate >0.5%

sre-ops: agree on measurable gates. also include KV cache warmup check — new model variant can cause cold-kv tail latency. checklist: 1) confirm errors, 2) check kv-hit ratios, 3) confirm no background job spike, 4) prepare revert command

mira: capturing. Customer-facing comms drafted if we revert: short expl + ETA. product-liaison can you review?

product-liaison: reviewed. keep it brief: "Experiencing elevated latency in EU; rolling back to restore SLA. We'll follow up with postmortem." ok to send after we flip the revert. :+1:

oliver: revert steps ready. operator override window: we need a tenant-safe approach — partial traffic cutover back to previous model for 30m then observe. Commands below (ops only):
```bash
# pin to previous model version
redwoodctl release pin --region eu --model-id rwd-model-v2.4.1
# trigger rollback routing (staged)
redwoodctl rollout revert --region eu --strategy staged --duration 30m
```

jay: add --no-autoscale flag to avoid capacity churn during staged cut. also set alert to escalate to oncall after 5m of sustained breach post-cutover.

oncall-bot: incident created: INC-2026-0456 (eu-latency-spike). bridge: https://inc.example/INC-2026-0456

sre-ops: operator handoff: who will execute? mira? oliver? need comm that we executed the revert + exact time and pinned version for customers + internal log entry.

mira: I can execute now. I'll wait 4 more minutes for metrics to stabilize. will call it at 6188801172 if conditions persist.

oliver: ack. I'll be on the bridge and monitor KV hit ratio and tails.

mira: executing pin+staged revert now. posting commands and timestamps to ops-log. will notify product + cust once stable.

deploybot: action: rollout revert started by mira at 6188801172. strategy=staged, duration=30m, pinned_version=rwd-model-v2.4.1

jay: monitoring p95 and error rate. if metrics not improved within 7m of revert completion, we'll open full rollback and customer update.

product-liaison: prepping the customer note: "We rolled back a recent update in EU to restore latency. We're investigating root cause; will share findings and ETA for returning to the release."

mira: revert completed at 6188801210. early signs: p95 dropped to 0.9s, errors back to baseline. I sent the customer note. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

sre-ops: closing loop: file a short postmortem with the measured kv-warmup hypothesis and add a temporary tweak to the auto-revert policy (lower trigger window to 3m for canaries) as an action item.

product-liaison: I'll coordinate the postmortem and external follow-up.

mira: filing ops ticket now. end thread.
